plot-title: Generalizability gate pass rate by corpus (extraction stage)
plot-caption: We report the share of norms that pass the extraction-stage generalizability gate, which flags any character- or plot-specific leakage. Both corpora pass at high rates: 95.6% for fiction10 versus 99.5% for top100 (Jensen-Shannon divergence, JSD = 0.013). The residual 4-point gap does not shrink on identical books (noise-floor ratio 1.15), so we read it as a run-level effect rather than a corpus-composition effect. Role abstraction has not yet been applied to either corpus.
